Commentary.Commentary: 239 is the target for England to wrap the series tonight itself. It does not look a big ask but it will not be an easy task. The pitch is turning and the ball is gripping but should the dew come into play, Mortaza will have his hands full. Join us back at 1815 IST (1245 GMT) to see if we have a contest.

England were excellent with the ball today. They made full use of the juice on the pitch early on and then, even when the swing was gone, they did not let the hosts get away. Rashid, Stokes and Moeen were brilliant, stemming the run-flow in the middle overs and towards the end, Ball and Woakes did really well. The last 4 overs went for just 28. The wickets were evenly distributed with Woakes, Rashid and Ball getting 2 apiece.

The hosts struggled to find supporting batsmen to Mahmudullah who was playig beautifully. He held one end up and made a lovely 75 but the others fell after getting starts. Towards the end, skipper Mashrafe Mortaza played a handy cameo of 44 from just 29 balls, taking his team close to the 240-mark.

Not a bad score given the circumstances the hosts were in. They got off to a poor start and were 39/3 before Mahmudullah and Rahim steadied things a bit. The stand was slow but was picking up when Rahim fell.
A dot ball to finish. A length ball outside off, Shafiul has a swing but misses. They do not take the bye either. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 238/8!
SHAFIUL ISLAM walks out to face the final ball...

OUT! Mortaza has run himself out. On middle and leg, Nasir gets across and looks to paddle but misses. He sighs in despair but Mortaza calls him through for the single. Nasir runs while Buttler has an underarm shy at the striker's end and hits. It is referred uptstairs and replays confirm that the Bangladesh skipper is well short. End of a decent knock.
Direct hit! Is Mortaza in trouble? It is referred upstairs but he is already walking...

Full on middle, Nasir works it wide of mid on and calls for two straightaway. The fielder comes running in and Nasir is happy with the single. But then the fielder misfields and Mortaza pushes Nasir into the second.
Outside off, slapped over covers for a couple.
Low full toss outside off, squeezed to point for a run.
Full and outside off, hit hard to mid off for a single.
Excellent yorker to finish, on middle, Mortaza just about manages to dig it out. Ball finishes with figures of 8-0-44-2.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a run.

FOUR! What a shot! Back of a length, angling in from outside off, Nasir arches back and deftly guides it past the diving Jos Buttler to the third man fence! Successive boundaries take this stand to 62 from 42 balls. Nasir moves to 42 from 27 balls.
FOUR! Pristine! Full and wide outside off, Nasir reaches out and drives it through point for a boundary!
A length ball wide outside off, Hossain slashes hard but misses.
Comes down the track, Ballbangs it in short, Nasir lets it go thinking it will be wided but it isn't.
Another full toss outside off, this is a high one, Mortaza slams it over point and gets a couple. Decent over for England, just 6 from it.
A length ball outside off, MM swings but misses.
Another full toss outside off, Mashrafe looks to steer it to third man but misses.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a brace. The skipper moves to 41 from 24 balls.
50-STAND IS UP IN 34 BALLS! Crucial stand.
Another low full toss on off, bunted down to long on for a run.
A low full toss wide outside off, steered behind point for a single.
CHRIS WOAKES is back on.
Smart bowling, slower bouncer outside off, Nasir looks to play the upper cut but misses.
A low full toss outside off, steered behind point for another single.
A full ball on off, pushed down to long on for a single.
Full and wide outside off, eaed through the covers for a couple. Nasir moves to 11 from 15 balls.
Banged in outside off, heaved to long on for a single.
Full on middle, heaved it through mid on for a couple.
JAKE BALL is back on.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single. 15 from the over!
WIDE. There tells the pressure as Willey bowls this full and wide outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Up and over! Crucial runs for Bangladesh. Full and wide outside off, Mortaza reaches out and lofts it over mid off for a boundary! Pressure on Willey, 13 from the over already! The captain is on 33 from just 18 balls.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
SIX! Just over! The short balls keep coming and Mortaza keeps swinging. He has another heave-ho and mistimes it, but has enough power on it to clear long on! The stand is worth 33 from 23 balls!
Short and outside off, MM swings again and toe-ends it to mid off.
WIDE. Too wide outside off, Mashrafe has another swing but cannot reach the ball.
Ugly batting. Backs away to the leg side, the bowler follows him, Mortaza swings hard but gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the keeper.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. They pick up a single.
Another short ball, slapped back past the bowler through mid on. Long on cuts it off with a slideand keeps the batsmen to a couple.

FOUR! The duck-hook! A steaming bouncer at the body, Mortaza initially ducks, then hooks it with his eyes closed and gets it towards deep mid-wicket. Two fielders converge but the one running to his right from mid-wicket fumbles and concedes the boundary.
A slower short ball, Mashrafe looks to pull but is way too early and misses. The ball goes off his body, past the stumps and to the keeper.
Landed outside off, defended to the off side.
Around off, worked through square leg for a single.
CHRIS WOAKES comes back on to bowl.
Full and wide outside off, steered to third man for one.

Short and outside off, pulled through mid-wicket. Jason Roy races to his left, slides, stops the ball and then picks up and throws in one motion. The throw is a good one to Willey but he misses the ball. Mortaza was a goner as the batsmen return for the second.
Full and outside off, pushed uppishly just over short extra cover for a run.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards short extra cover.
Full and outside off, Nasir looks to drive but is beaten.
DAVID WILLEY comes back on.
SIX! Second one of the over! Moeen gives this plenty of flight outside off, Mortaza gets under it and swings it mightily over long on! 12 from the over!
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Spins in from outside off, MM looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, Mashrafe lunges and pokes but misses.
Down the leg side, nudged straight to short fine leg.
SIX! First one of the day! Full and outside off, Mortaza comes forward and lofts it over mid off who is inside the circle and clears the boundary as well!
Tossed up outside off, spinning away, Nasir watches it go past. That is the end of Rashid, yet another decent outing for him - 10-0-53-2.
Full and outside off, Mortaza drives it through the covers where Jason Roy dives to his left but misfields and concedes the single.
MASHRAFE MORTAZA walks in at number 9, replacing Mosaddek.

OUT! Caught! Mosaddek falls now. A long hop outside off, Mosaddek heaves it towards deep mid-wicket but is unable to hit it cleanly as the ball does not arrive at all. He holes out to deep mid-wicket where Moeen Ali takes it with ease. The home side has lost two quick wickets now.
Short and outside off again, steered straight to short third man.
Short and ouside off, pulled uppishly over mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE. A loopy googly outside off, does not spin back enough and goes outside the wide guidelines. Left alone and is wided.
Tossed up around off, defended on the pitch.
Spins in from outside off, tucked towards backward square leg where Sam Billings takes his eyes off the ball and misfields and concedes the second.
Outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle and off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off, steered straight to short third man.

Around off, spinning in, Nasir looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the gloves. The ball lobs in the air but neither the batsman nor the keeper know where the ball is and it lands right in front.
Full and outside off, pushed down to long on for a single.
POWERPLAY 3 signalled by the umpire. 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

Full ad wide outside off, Nasir reaches out and drives it through the covers. Once again, David Willey showcases excellent fielding skills as he runs across to his right and dives to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
NASIR HOSSAIN walks in at number 8, replacing Mahmudullah.

OUT! LBW! The decision stays as it is. Full and outside off, Mahmudullah tried another lap sweep but missed and was hit on the pads. Rashid appealed and the umpire raised his finger. Mahmudullah was furious with himself but was happy to walk off the field, not interested in challenging the umpire's decision. But someone from the dressing room asked him to take the review and he did. Not quite sure whether that is allowed according to the rule books. The umpire obliged anyways but Hawk Eye did not disagree with him. Hit in line, no inside edge or glove and crashing into leg stump. That ends a fine knock from Mahmudullah. Pretty much a lone hand.
This time a review taken by Bangladesh. Mahmudullah has been adjudged LBW and he wants it reviewed, albiet, on someone's insistence from the dressing room.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Mahmudullah gets out and sweeps it over square leg for a boundary!
Shorter on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and aound off, watchfully defended.
A touch wider outside off, Hossain reaches out and works it towards widish long on for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed back to Moeen again.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Mosaddek looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, Hossain looks to run it down to third man but misses.

MASSIVE INSIDE EDGE. That is a very poor review from England. Buttler should have known about the inside edge. Mosaddek looked to defend but missed and was hit on the pads. Rashid appealed and convinced Buttler to go for the review. Replays detected the piece of wood straightaway.
Review taken by England. It is against an LBW decision. The on-air commentators feel there is an inside edge involved.
FOUR! Poor ball from Rashid, drops it short and outside off, Mosaddek goes back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary! The stand is worth 41 from 58 balls.

Full and outside off, driven beautifully through the covers. David Willey covers good ground to his right from sweeper cover and slides to half-stop the ball. Nearly parries it into the fence but he recovers quickly and returns the ball. Two runs taken. 150 UP FOR BANGLADESH! Mosaddek moves to 20 from 34 balls.
On middle and leg, worked towards backward square leg.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Change of ends for Rashid.
Full and outside off, pushed down to long on for a run.
Floated outside off, driven straight to cover-point.
Around off, gently nudged towards square leg.
Outside off, Mosaddek looks to run it down to third man but is beaten.
Around off, gently worked through mid-wicket for a single. Moves to 70 from 85 balls.

FOUR! Delicately done. Full on middle and off, Mahmudullah gets down and across and gently paddles this past Jos Buttler who almost got to the ball, to the fine leg fence. The stand is worth 33 from 49 balls.
Nothing much on the Free Hit. A slower ball outside off, on a length, Mahmudullah heaves hard but only gets a thick inside edge towards square leg. Just a run taken. 12 from the over.
FREE HIT coming up. The field can be changed as the strike changed.
NO BALL! Pretty clear call from the umpire as Stokes oversteps, bowls it full and wide outside off, MH reaches out and steers it behind point for a single.
Landed outside off, a play and a miss.
Landed outside off, punched towards cover.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Albeit not the best of shots. Stokes lands this outside off and Hossain looks to run it down to third man with a slip in place. He gets an outsideedge which just eludes that fielder and runs to the third man fence. Not the wisest of shots but the crowd does not mind it.
FOUR! What a shot. On a good length outside off, Mosaddek just oushes this through the covers and gets a boundary. The stand is worth 22 from 44 balls now. Mosaddek is on 12 from 23 balls now.
Short and outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
LEADING EDGE, JUST WIDE! Full and outside off, Hossain looks to flick it to the leg side but gets a leading edge just wide of the diving bowler towards mid off!
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
On the pads, tucked to short fine leg for a run.
Around off, this is worked with softer hands through mid-wicket and a single is taken.
Full and outside off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outsde off, Mahmudullah reverse laps it just over Jos Buttler towards short third man. Just a single for all that effort.
Short and outside off, Mosaddek hops and looks to play the cut but mistimes it to cover.
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Down the leg side, Mahmudullah misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads past a diving Buttler towards fine leg. Moeen Ali dives at the boundary to save a couple of runs. Leg byes signalled.
There is a bit of rain in the air now...
Around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge which pops onto his pads and goes to short mid-wicket.
DRINKS BREAK.

Full and outside off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Can he get cheekier than that? Landed outside off, spinning in, Mosaddek comes forward and flicks it between the keeper and leg slip to the fine leg fence! Just a ball ago, the fielder had moved squarer.
On middle and leg, flicked past leg slip for a run.
Full on middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. Moves to 60 from 74 balls.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
A low full toss outside off, played straight to David Willey at point.

On middle, played straight to short mid-wicket.

Similar ball, this is a bit closer, another play and a miss.

Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.

The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.

OUT! Gloved down the leg side! Unlucky for Shakib. It was a length ball outside leg, Shakib looked to shoulder arms but the ball came into him, took the glove and went down the leg side. Straightforward catch for Buttler. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger!
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.

The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Short and outside off, spinning away, slapped to deep point for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed down to long on for a single.
Here comes the sixth bowler of the day - MOEEN ALI.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full and outside off, angling away, Hasan looks to push it to the off side but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Shakib misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Short and outside off, punched sweetly through the covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
16th ODI Fifty for Mahmudullah, 1st vs England.

FOUR! Well bowled and very well played. Full and outside off, gets it to move away, Mahmudullah adjusts well and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to guide it through the vacant slip cordon to third man. It has been a good knock so far.
BEN STOKES comes on to bowl now.
Pushes this through the covers for one.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

A full toss outside off, pushed down to ground to mid off.
Full on middle, Mahmudullah gets down it down and paddles it fine for three runs. The stand moves to 10 from 9 balls.

Nearly drags it on! Ball comes in from wde of the crease, over the wicket, Hasan looks to run it down but ends up getting a thick inside edge which just misses the off stump and goes to the keeper.
Landed outside off, chopped into the ground straight to point.
A wild bouncer on middle, Shakib watches it soar over his head.
Outside off, steered thriugh point for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, Shakib gets across and works it through square leg for a single.

Played to the point region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total. Good urgency shown in running.

On middle and leg, played straight to square leg.

OUT! Well taken! Ball gets his second. A short ball on middle, Rahim goes for the pull but is not in control at all. He miscues it to fine leg where Moeen Ali comes running in and takes a very good catch. Bangladesh back in trouble now.
50-RUN STAND IS UP IN 51 BALLS!
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, well defended.
Outsie off, played straight to point.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They manage to come back for the second.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The batsman dances down the track.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.

Punches this past the bowler for a run.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, placed through the covers for a run.
Full and wide outside off, Mahmudullah reaches out and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. Mahmudullah moves to 31 from 30 balls, while the stand is worth 41 from 37 balls.
FOUR! Wallop! Short on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Landed outside off, played straight to cover.

A low full toss on middle, swept powerfully through mid-wicket. James Vince gives it a good chase and dives to his left at the fence and pulls it back but it rolls back in. He tries to push it away but while doing so, he touche the ropes. David Willey returns the throw but the effort from Vince is referred upstairs and replays show that it is a boundary.
Full and wide outside off, driven sweetly through point for one.
Landed outside off, gently paddled through square leg for a run. The stand moves to 30 from 32 balls.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Landed outside off, pushed through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Majestic! Tossed up too wide outside off, Mahmudullah leans and drievs it through the covers for a boundary! Moves to 23 from 25 balls.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg bye signalled by the umpire.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
On a good length outside off, generates steep bounce, Rahim hops and works it through mid-wicket for a quick single.
4000 ODI runs for Mushfiqur Rahim!
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, punched through cover for a run.
Full and outside off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge wide of mid-wicket. A single taken.
A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket. Jonny Bairstow runs to his left from deep square leg and dives to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
DRINKS BREAK.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
BOUNCE... That came from nowhere. Off cutter outside off, Mushfiqur came forward to defend but the ball shot up from nowhere and beat him. Suspect it hit one of the cracks.
Similar ball, this is punched towards point.
This one cuts back in, Rahim stays back to defend.
Landed outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Full toss on middle, pushed down to long on for a run to bring up the 50 FOR BANGLADESH.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.

Don't think he intended to play it there. Full and outside off, Mahmudullah looked to defend but the ball stayed extremely low. However, the batsman did open the bat-face and the ball went past slip to third man. Two runs taken.
Slows the pace up a bit, tossed the ball, Mahmudullah looks to defend but misses and is hit on the thigh pads.
Short and outside off, the batsman looks to cut but gets a bottom edge onto the pitch.
Floated around off, Mahmudullah looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Landed outside off, nips back in, Mushfiqur tries to run it down to third man but misses and is hit on the chest.
FOUR! Magnificent! Ball pitches itup this time, Rahim comes forward and drives it exquisitely through mid off for a boundary!
FOUR! Nice way to get off the mark. Around off, angling in, Rahim opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a boundary!
MUSHFIQUR RAHIM walks in at number 5, replacing Sabbir.

OUT! Chops it on! Ball strikes almost straightaway. Short in length outside off, Sabbir stays back to steer it to third man but the extra bounce does him in. Is cramped for room and gets a thick inside edge onto his stumps.
Interesting. Jumps down the track and swats it wide of mid on but Adil Rashid dives to his right and makes a one-handed stop.
The hero of the other night, JAKE BALL, comes on to bowl.
Floated around off, defended with a lunge. Steady start from Rashid.
Goes deep in his crease and works it through mid-wicket. Sabbir wanted the second and what was halfway down the track but was sent back.
Around leg, the batsman flicks it towards short fine leg.
Short around leg, Mahmudullah looks to pull it away but gloves it down to short fine leg.
Landed around off, spinning away, pushed through the covers for a single.
Around middle, defended towards short mid-wicket.
First signs of spin. ADIL RASHID into the attack.
Full on middle, flicked uppishly but it does not carry to short mid-wicket.
Banged in short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
WIDE. Short and way too high, Mahmudullah lets it go. Wide signalled.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On a length outside off, Sabbir flashes but misses.

LEADING EDGE, SAFE! On a good length around middle, Mahmudullah looks to turn it to the leg side but is a bit early into the same. Gets a leading edge which goes behind point to third man. A single taken.
A bouncer outside off, Sabbir lets it go. Surprisingly, no wide signalled.

On middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket where Moeen Ali dives to stop the ball. A run taken as it was not a clean stop.

Short and outside off, slapped behind point for a single.
POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. Four fielders allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side.

Short and outside off, Sabbir goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge back onto the ground.
Outside off, not played at.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler who deflects it to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! What a shot. On middle, Mahmudullah whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
MAHMUDULLAH walks in at number 4, replacing Tamim.

OUT! Caught! Straight to the man! A short ball on middle, Tamim swivels and pulls it away but straight to Moeen Ali at short mid-wicket! The plan of bowling short works again and Bangladesh have lost both their openers.
On a good length around middle, worked straight to square leg.
Shorter in length, Iqbal looks to pull but is beaten by the lack of pace and mistimes it to short mid-wicket again.
Huh? What a shot. On a good length around middle, Tamim jumps and looks to punch it down the ground but the ball runs off the inner half of the bat towars short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, angling away, left alone.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.

Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.

SABBIR RAHMAN walks in at number 3, replacing Kayes.

OUT! Caught! Straight into the trap! The plan was on. There was a deep mid-wicket in place and fine leg was moved pretty square. Woakes banged it in short and Kayes immediately swivelled for the pull, like he did in Woakes' last over. Only this time, he was a bit early as Woakes took some pace off the ball. As a result, a top edge was induced which was taken calmly by David Willey at deep backward square leg.
A short ball on middle, Imrul goes for the hook but misses.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.

A CATCH? Not quite. Leg bye signalled. A length ball on middle and leg, Kayes goes for the pull but is beaten by the pace and the ball lobs off something behind. Jos Buttler runs forward and dives and takes it. He does not appeal but the crowd thinks it is a catch and falls silent. That immediately turns into a roar as Umpire Aleem Dar signals a leg bye.
Outside off, played straight to point.

DROPPED! The plan nearly worked! The off side was packed and Tamim was forced to go over the top. He got a full ball and lunged into an uppish square drive. Jason Roy threw himself to his left from backward pointand did well to get to the ball in the first place. Unfortunately he could not cling on. The ball was stopped near the boundary and a couple of runs were taken.
FOUR! Lovely! That will give him confidence. Full and outside off, swinging away, Tamim strides forward and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary! Moves to 10.
Around middle, gently nudged through square leg. Tamim wants two but is sent back after the single.
Full and outside off, swinging away, driven straight to cver.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Violence! Slightly short on middle, angling away, Kayes swivels and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
On a good length on leg stump, Kayes backs away to the leg side and attempts a run-down to third man but misses and the ball goes over the stumps.

A short ball around middle, Iqbal pulls this through square leg. Moeen Ali rushes across from short mid-wicket and slides but half-stops the ball. He recovers and runs after that ball but by then, a run is taken.
Pressure building with the dots here. A length ball outside off, angling away, Tamim goes for a big heave down the ground amd gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
Change of bats for Tamim.
Landed around middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, played straight to point. This has been a disciplined start from England.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out again.
Landed around off, watchfully defended.
He goes hard at this one and gets a THICK INSIDE EDGE past the stumps to short fine leg. There was no foot movement there. A run taken.
Full and wide outside off, slanting away, a drive and a miss from Kayes.
There he goes. Down the track is Tamim but Willey shortens his length and Tamim is cramped for room. Just about fends it to the leg side and scampers through for a quick single.
Full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
An odd field change. A leg slip comes in but fine leg stays where he was.
Down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Shorter in length, around off, Iqbal mistimes his cut to cover. Nasser Hussain on air says that a year ago, that would have disappeared. But now, Woakes has developed some pace and become skiddier.
Fuller around middle, turned straight to short mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, angling away, Tamim punches this towards point and as he does that, his bottom hand comes off the bat.
Around off, punched straight to cover.
Lovely shot. But for nothing. Half volley outside off, swinging away, driven straight to short cover.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Kayes takes his bat away from the line.
Landed outside off, punched to the off side.
Around off this time, tucked through mid-wicket for a single. There is a man in the deep.
More outswing, slightly shorter of fuller length, pushed confidently towards wide mid off.
Full and around off, some outswing, which Woakes did not get, Tamim comes forward and blocks.
DAVID WILLEY to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. He comes charging in but Tamim is not ready so Willey has to stop halfway. Tamim smiles and apologizes.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
FOUR! That is the shot of a man in knick. Slightly short of a length outside off, Kayes opens the face of the bat and steers it behind point for a boundary.
Bangladesh are away. Full on middle, TI flicks it wide of mid on for a single.
Around off, pushed straight to point.
On a good length outside off, angling away, Iqbal keeps his bat inside the line.
A lovely yorker first up, on middle, Tamim just about digs it out.

The players are out in the middle! Tamim Iqbal and Imrul Kayes are the openers for the home side. CHRIS WOAKES to start off proceedings for the game. Tamim to face wth two slips in place. Here we go...
BANGLADESH TEAM NEWS - Mosharraf Hossain injured his hand in the previous game and hence, misses out on this one. NASIR HOSSAIN replaces him.
ENGLAND TEAM NEWS - There was some doubt over the fitness of Jonny Bairstow for England but he has passed the test and is ready to play. So that means the visitors have an unchanged side.

TOSS - Jos Buttler calls it correctly again and this time, ENGLAND WILL CHASE. This has got more to do with the fact that the pitch was under cover and hence, could hav developed some moisture. Mashrafe too, admits that he would have liked to bowl first as well.

Things could not have started better for Jos Buttler as a captain. The wole world is taking about Jake Ball's dramatic turnaround but both the captain and his bowler would admit that it was more of Bangladesh's nervousness that the visitors were able to win. However, they would love to build on that confidence and seal the series tonight itself.

After snatching defeat from the jaws of victory on Friday, hosts Bangladesh will hope for today to turn into a Super Sunday as they take on England in the second ODI at Mirpur. There was nothing much in that game really, apart from Bangladesh losing the plot in the last 30 minutes. They faced a similar situation against India in the WT20. Can they recover from that and level the series tonight?
